youtube_schedule.link_policy: Canonical YouTube URL from a validated ID only; no link for an absent or conflicting ID.
youtube_schedule.identity_policy: Match published facts by validated video ID only. Never match by inferred title or create a video ID for an unassigned slot.
youtube_schedule.row_policy: Exclude headers and section metadata. Count date-only empty slots separately; show a form-bearing slot without a title as an undetermined slot.
youtube_schedule.metric_policy: Do not consume H:O performance cells. Unpublished or unmatched rows have unavailable metrics and never enter publication or quality denominators.
youtube_schedule.cancellation_status: 확인 못 함: A:G and the inspected headers contain no independent cancellation column; do not infer cancellation.
youtube_schedule.freshness_basis: Successful source collection timestamp; not the publication-metrics timestamp or dashboard build timestamp.

ad_gen.basis: General-ad bookings by date month under the canonical non-CANCEL rule; no RAW-only party filter.

ad_int.basis: Contract amount by contract start month.

live.basis: Confirmed booking package fee by 진행월; never cost_raw or RAW AF.

MBD_TOTAL.basis: Sum of the three forecast components.

revenue_forecast.validation: Require one row per expected team, exact provenance, finite nonnegative integer amounts and an exact team-to-total reconciliation.

revenue_actual.basis: Included canonical monthly actuals; close only through the explicit month-close flow. Daily quality refresh does not reopen a close.
revenue_actual.legacy_exception: The August 2026 close uses the approved July comparison retained in LEGACY_PREVIOUS_BY_REVIEW_MONTH; do not claim that baseline came from integrated_ssot.

components.ad_gen: ad_gen.booking_pred.revenue; date within month-to-cutoff, ad_type 일반광고, normalized status not CANCEL/CANCELLED, party_type 3P/제3자/판촉결합.
components.ad_int: ad_int.contract.미셀 매출액; 매출 귀속월 matches YYYYMM and 계약 시작일 is on or before cutoff.
components.live: live.raw_slots.AF수취액; 온에어 일자 within month-to-cutoff, exact 3P, free/cancel tokens excluded from package/program/promotion text.

revenue_mtd.comparison: Previous same-day month-to-date with identical filters, clamped to prior month end; restated on the current snapshot, not an archived as-known-then value.

revenue_targets.basis: Three-team revenue targets. Excludes other company lines and Live GMV targets.
revenue_targets.next_booking: The next-month preview, header, teams and chart share canonical forecast components and the next month's three-team targets.

live_schedule.basis: Full selected month, excluding 취소/cancel tokens in package/program/promotion text. Includes free and future slots and preserves same-date/same-brand separate broadcasts.
live_schedule.metric_policy: Future metrics are unavailable. Missing values and unmeasured-slot placeholder zeroes are unavailable; source count is separate from performance count.

live_performance.basis: Month-to-cutoff rows with positive 1D GMV; excludes free/cancel tokens. No revenue-only 1P/3P filter.
live_performance.average: Sum of positive 1D brand-daily GMV divided by the included broadcast row count; not forecast revenue or the full schedule count.

youtube_published.basis: Active videos published within the selected month through the cutoff. Sheet schedules do not create publication facts.
youtube_published.format_policy: LF/SF and other published formats stay in their existing cohorts; schedule-only 커뮤니티/라이브 rows do not enter any publication denominator.

youtube_metrics.d7: Latest eligible fact_analytics_d7 row per ID, ordered by completion, fetched_at and metric_end_date. D7 averages use completed published videos only.
youtube_metrics.pis: Published D7 like_count + comment_count + share_count; not sheet H:O or an invented score for a schedule.
youtube_metrics.subscribers: Latest monthly v_channel_daily_subscribers row; existing current-month carry-forward behavior is preserved.
youtube_metrics.snapshot_label: Global max fact_snapshot.snapshot_date remains a metrics clock and does not certify schedule freshness.

youtube_period_metrics.basis: Existing channel period metrics and completed D+N content view. Metric periods and publication cohorts remain distinct from calendar schedule weeks.

verification_policy.completion: Verify source collection, validated cache, rendered row coverage, unchanged performance denominators, required tests and exact published-artifact readback when deployment is authorized.
